answer: Underwriting rings price sybil risk jointly. The trigger is a confirmed duplicate: the ledger traces a clone back to its co-underwriting ring. The rule limits each ring to five members, every one depositing 5,000 POA into the knoll escrow, and a single confirmed clone burns the entire ring's deposit. The cost is explicit: every fake identity forfeits 25,000 POA, so a hundred clones drain 1,000,000 POA across their rings while the fable of cheap clones fades, since honest agents stay unringed and every crystal-clear bond is real.
